title: Packaging a finite free exact sequence as a bounded projective resolution
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $d\in\mathbf N$, and $S$ an exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of $d+3$ arrows in the category of $R$-modules, indexed from $0$ to $d+3$. Assume $S_0$ and $S_{d+3}$ are zero, and each $S_{i+1}$ for $0\le i\le d$ is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then $S_{d+2}$ has a projective resolution [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension] whose terms are finite free in every degree and zero in every degree strictly greater than $d$.

source.place: Tag 0CXF (lemma-what-kind-of-resolutions-Noetherian-local), condition (7); categorical encoding of its finite exact sequence

proof.text: Define X_i = S_(d+1-i) using truncated natural subtraction, and define adjacent differentials from the corresponding arrows of S. For i>d, X_i is S_0 and hence zero. Consecutive maps compose to zero by exactness when i<d and by the zero source otherwise. Form ChainComplex.of.

For i≤d, rewrite d+1-i=(d-i)+1 to inherit finite freeness from S. Above d use the zero-object subsingleton instance. Free modules are projective (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Projective). Exactness in positive degrees is inherited from the corresponding consecutive arrows, or follows from a zero middle term.

Take the augmentation S_(d+1) → S_(d+2). Exactness with the right zero endpoint makes it epic. Exactness at S_(d+1) identifies its kernel with the image from degree one. ChainComplex.toSingle₀Equiv packages the augmentation, and ChainComplex.quasiIsoAt₀_iff together with ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros′ proves quasi-isomorphism at zero. In positive degrees both complexes are exact, giving quasi-isomorphism by quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt′. These data give ProjectiveResolution with the degreewise properties proved above.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_bounded_finite_free_resolution_of_exact_sequence
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ)
    (S : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (d + 3))
    (hS : S.Exact) (hzero : IsZero (S.obj' 0)) (hlast : IsZero (S.obj' (d + 3)))
    (hfree : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ d),
      Module.Finite R (S.obj' (i + 1) (by omega)) ∧
        Module.Free R (S.obj' (i + 1) (by omega))) :
    ∃ P : ProjectiveResolution (S.obj' (d + 2)),
      (∀ i : ℕ, d < i → IsZero (P.complex.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, Module.Finite R (P.complex.X i) ∧ Module.Free R (P.complex.X i))
